note: The abstract describes existing hardware defenses against cache-based covert channels and argues they fail against implicit variants, positioning TrackRISC against such defenses; DAWG is a prominent defense in this space likely cited in this context, but no direct naming is present in the abstract evidence.
title: TrackRISC: An Implicit Attack Flow Model and Hardware Microarchitectural Mitigation for Speculative Cache-Based Covert Channels
